description: On a two-element domain one can choose witnesses \(x,z\) and a unary relation \(P\) with \(P(x)\), \(\neg P(z)\), and every element equal to one of the witnesses.
signature: Lemmatheca.Entry.ExistentialUniversalSentences.two_point_example : ∃ P x z, P x ∧ ¬P z ∧ ∀ (y : Bool), y = x ∨ y = z
